passed_checks.check_name: Ensure KMS key policy does not contain wildcard (*) principal
code_block:
DatabaseBackupKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed KMS key for encrypting database backups (${Environment}).'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      MultiRegion: false
      PendingWindowInDays: !Ref PendingWindowInDays
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: database-backup-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAWSBackupServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 'backup.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowRDSServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: rds.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 'rds.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: DenyKeyDeletionWithoutMFA
            Effect: Deny
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:Delete*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              BoolIfExists:
                'aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent': 'false'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: database-backup-key
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: DatabaseBackupEncryption
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: RotationEnabled
          Value: 'true'
